svg.text: Tourniquet: architecture on AWS · ap-southeast-2 · proven on real AWS, 24 Nov 2026

Red squares mark the cut that lands on that service: 1 Cedar forbid · 2 vault deny · 3 cut agent calls · 4 stop sessions · 5 tool Lambda concurrency 0 · 6 role lock · 7 deactivate keys · 8 rotate secret
Dashed teal = service group · dotted = not enabled in the demo (a finding of the right shape is sent in) · the red outline is the agent that gets hijacked
